after.name: review_sentinel
after.sql: CREATE TABLE review_sentinel (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value VARCHAR(80))

after.name: customer_consent_events_retain_delete
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_events_retain_delete` BEFORE DELETE ON `customer_consent_events` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (0=1); END

after.name: customer_consent_events_retain_insert
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_events_retain_insert` BEFORE INSERT ON `customer_consent_events` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (NEW.purpose='email_marketing' AND NEW.source='first_party_customer' AND NEW.revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483646 AND length(NEW.recipient_hmac)=64 AND NEW.recipient_hmac NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' AND length(CAST(NEW.recipient_ciphertext AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND length(NEW.public_id)=36 AND ((NEW.status='granted' AND NEW.affirmative=1 AND NEW.policy_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NEW.status='withdrawn' AND NEW.affirmative=0)) AND (NEW.policy_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_policies WHERE id=NEW.policy_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose)) AND NEW.revision=COALESCE((SELECT revision FROM customer_consent_states WHERE customer_account_id=NEW.customer_account_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose),0)+1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_accounts a JOIN users u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE a.id=NEW.customer_account_id AND a.active=1 AND u.is_admin=0 AND u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_events WHERE id=NEW.id OR public_id=NEW.public_id OR (customer_account_id=NEW.customer_account_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose AND revision=NEW.revision))); END

after.name: customer_consent_events_retain_update
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_events_retain_update` BEFORE UPDATE ON `customer_consent_events` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (0=1); END

after.name: customer_consent_policies_retain_delete
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_policies_retain_delete` BEFORE DELETE ON `customer_consent_policies` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (0=1); END

after.name: customer_consent_policies_retain_insert
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_policies_retain_insert` BEFORE INSERT ON `customer_consent_policies` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (NEW.purpose='email_marketing' AND length(NEW.version) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND length(NEW.notice) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(CAST(NEW.notice AS BLOB))<=8000 AND length(NEW.review_reference) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(CAST(NEW.review_reference AS BLOB))<=800 AND length(NEW.notice_hash)=64 AND NEW.notice_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' AND length(NEW.policy_hash)=64 AND NEW.policy_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_policies WHERE id=NEW.id OR (purpose=NEW.purpose AND version=NEW.version))); END

after.name: customer_consent_policies_retain_update
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_policies_retain_update` BEFORE UPDATE ON `customer_consent_policies` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (0=1); END

after.name: customer_consent_states_retain_delete
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_states_retain_delete` BEFORE DELETE ON `customer_consent_states` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (0=1); END

after.name: customer_consent_states_retain_insert
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_states_retain_insert` BEFORE INSERT ON `customer_consent_states` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (NEW.purpose='email_marketing' AND NEW.revision=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_events WHERE id=NEW.event_id AND customer_account_id=NEW.customer_account_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose AND revision=NEW.revision) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_states WHERE id=NEW.id OR (customer_account_id=NEW.customer_account_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose))); END

after.name: customer_consent_states_retain_update
after.sql: CREATE TRIGGER `customer_consent_states_retain_update` BEFORE UPDATE ON `customer_consent_states` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Retained consent graph refused') WHERE NOT (NEW.id=OLD.id AND NEW.customer_account_id=OLD.customer_account_id AND NEW.purpose=OLD.purpose AND NEW.created_at=OLD.created_at AND NEW.revision=OLD.revision+1 AND NEW.revision<=2147483646 AND NEW.updated_at>=OLD.updated_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_consent_events WHERE id=NEW.event_id AND customer_account_id=NEW.customer_account_id AND purpose=NEW.purpose AND revision=NEW.revision)); END
